name: WaveBar: Waveform Media Controller
author: Erik Burdett
description: A waveform media controller focused on meaningful browser and desktop-player sessions.

barWidget.description: Now playing, live waveform, and MPRIS controls

schema.label: Show playback controls
schema.description: Show previous, play/pause, and next controls in the bar.

schema.label: Show track title
schema.description: Show the scrolling track title beside the waveform on horizontal bars.

schema.label: Hide when paused
schema.description: Remove WaveBar from the bar while the selected media source is paused.

schema.label: Waveform width
schema.description: Waveform width in pixels on horizontal bars.

schema.label: Maximum title width
schema.description: Maximum scrolling-title width in pixels on horizontal bars.
